decisions.statement: Every value the shell has is quoted rather than trusted.
The content hash is stamped last.
A failed step leaves the service stale rather than current.
An always-on service is loaded at login and kept alive.
A pool service is not loaded at login and is not kept alive.
A launchd bootstrap that fails on input/output or on being in progress is retried.
A launchd bootstrap that fails any other way is raised.

definition: the shell a host is asked to run to report, provision or tear down a service
